# Tendderr

> Tendderr helps small and mid-sized contractors find suitable public-sector contracts and prepare tenders, in England, Wales and Northern Ireland, plus Irish eTenders support. We don't cover Scotland. Sectors: commercial cleaning, grounds maintenance, property maintenance, minor construction and refurbishment, trades and repairs (electrical, plumbing, heating, roofing), pest control, and facilities management. Fixed fees, published up front, no commission: clients keep 100% of what they win.

Key facts:
- Business: Tendderr is a trading name of a sole trader based in Leeds, West Yorkshire, UK. Not VAT registered.
- Contact: phone 0333 339 7931 (+44 333 339 7931), answered by a real person; email hello@tendderr.com; website https://tendderr.com/
- Prices (GBP, fixed fees):
  - Tender alerts and suitability check: free
  - Review of one bid answer: free (email hello@tendderr.com)
  - Bid packs (bid preparation): Essential from £495 (single lot, standard ITT, up to about five quality questions); Standard from £750 (larger quality section, or PSQ plus ITT); Complete from £995 (multi-lot or complex bids, social value plan included)
  - DPS or dynamic market application: from £395
  - Full framework application: from £795
  - Bid-ready pack (Central Digital Platform registration done with you, six core policies, one-page capability statement): £195, credited against a later bid pack
  - 'Tender Ready' starter bundle: £295 (bid-ready pack, social value plan add-on and a free tender alert setup call; saves £45)
  - Re-bid bundle: from £575 (lost-bid review plus an Essential bid pack for the re-tender; saves £45)
  - Lost-bid review and re-bid plan: £125 (free for Tendderr's own bid clients)
  - Social value plan: £145 as an add-on, £245 standalone
  - Subcontracting route pack: £195
- No commission: clients keep 100% of what they win. Prices are "from" prices for a fixed fee agreed before work starts. No VAT added.
- Quotes: send the tender documents to hello@tendderr.com (subject "Tender for a quote"). We'll send a fixed quote within 2 working days of receiving your tender documents.
- Contract renewal alerts: included free in the tender alert; flags suitable contracts nearing expiry before they're re-tendered.
- Free tools (run in the browser, nothing stored): tender readiness checker, tender timeline calculator, social value and PPN checklist.
- Guides cite GOV.UK and official portals and were last checked 30 October 2026. They're general information, not legal advice.

## Services
- [Free Public Sector Tender Alerts for Contractors](https://tendderr.com/services/tender-alerts.html): Free public-sector tender alerts matched by a person to your trade and area, with contract renewal alerts and a free suitability check. England, Wales and NI.
- [Framework and DPS Application Help, from £395](https://tendderr.com/services/framework-dps-applications.html): Help getting onto public-sector frameworks, DPSs and dynamic markets: from £395 for a DPS or dynamic market, from £795 for a full framework. No commission.
- [Bid-Ready Pack: CDP Registration and Tender Policies, £195](https://tendderr.com/services/bid-ready-pack.html): Bid-ready pack, £195: Central Digital Platform registration done with you on a call, six core policies and a one-page capability statement.
- [Bid Writing for Public Sector Tenders, Fixed Fee](https://tendderr.com/services/bid-preparation.html): Fixed-fee bid writing for public-sector tenders: Essential from £495, Standard from £750, Complete from £995. Fixed quote within 2 working days. No commission.
- [Lost Tender Review and Re-Bid Plan, £125](https://tendderr.com/services/lost-bid-review.html): Lost a tender? A plain-English review of your assessment summary and a re-bid plan for next time. £125, free for our own bid clients.
- [Social Value Plan for Tenders, from £145](https://tendderr.com/services/social-value-plan.html): Social value commitments written for your tender, with numbers, owners and reporting dates you can deliver. £145 as an add-on, £245 standalone.
- [Subcontracting Route Pack: Supply Chain Registration, £195](https://tendderr.com/services/subcontracting-route-pack.html): Too small to bid direct? Find the main contractors winning public work near you and get onto their supply chains. Subcontracting route pack, £195.
- [Tender Writing and Bid Support Prices](https://tendderr.com/services/): No commission: keep 100% of what you win. Free tender alerts, bid packs from £495, DPS from £395, frameworks from £795, bundles from £295. No VAT added.

## Sectors
- [Cleaning Tenders and Public Sector Cleaning Contracts](https://tendderr.com/sectors/commercial-cleaning.html): Cleaning tenders from councils, schools, NHS trusts and housing associations in England, Wales and NI. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no win fee.
- [Grounds Maintenance Tenders and Landscaping Contracts](https://tendderr.com/sectors/grounds-maintenance.html): Grounds maintenance and landscaping tenders from councils, schools and housing associations. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no win fee.
- [Property Maintenance Tenders: Repairs and Voids Contracts](https://tendderr.com/sectors/property-maintenance.html): Property maintenance, repairs and voids tenders from housing associations, councils and schools. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no win fee.
- [Construction Tenders for Small Builders and Refurbishment](https://tendderr.com/sectors/minor-construction.html): Construction and refurbishment tenders for small builders: councils, schools, housing associations. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no win fee.
- [Trades Tenders: Electrical, Plumbing, Heating and Roofing](https://tendderr.com/sectors/trades.html): Electrical, plumbing, heating and roofing tenders from housing associations, councils and schools. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no commission.
- [Pest Control Tenders and Public Sector Contracts](https://tendderr.com/sectors/pest-control.html): Pest control tenders from councils, housing associations, schools and NHS trusts in England, Wales and NI. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no commission.
- [Facilities Management Tenders: Hard and Soft FM Contracts](https://tendderr.com/sectors/facilities-management.html): Hard and soft FM tenders from NHS trusts, universities, councils and schools. Free tender alerts, fixed-fee bid help, no commission and no win fee.
- [Public Sector Tenders by Trade: Sectors We Cover](https://tendderr.com/sectors/): Public-sector tenders for cleaning, grounds, property maintenance, construction, trades, pest control and FM contractors. Free alerts, fixed fees, no commission.

## Guides
- [Procurement Act 2023 Explained for Small Suppliers](https://tendderr.com/guides/procurement-act-2023.html): Procurement Act 2023 in plain English for small suppliers: 2026 thresholds, below-threshold rules, assessment summaries, standstill and payment. GOV.UK sourced.
- [How to Register on the Central Digital Platform](https://tendderr.com/guides/central-digital-platform-registration.html): Register free on the Central Digital Platform (Find a Tender) in three steps, get your unique identifier (PPON) and know what to have ready. GOV.UK sourced.
- [Frameworks, DPS and Dynamic Markets Explained](https://tendderr.com/guides/frameworks-dps-dynamic-markets.html): How frameworks, open frameworks, DPSs and dynamic markets work under the Procurement Act 2023: terms, reopening and fees. Sourced from GOV.UK.
- [Social Value in Public Sector Tenders: PPN 002 and PPN 026](https://tendderr.com/guides/social-value-in-tenders.html): Social value in public tenders: the 10% minimum weighting under PPN 002, the PPN 026 model from 1 January 2027, and commitments you can deliver.
- [Where to Find Public Sector Tenders (UK and NI)](https://tendderr.com/guides/find-public-sector-tenders.html): Free official portals for public-sector tenders: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder, Sell2Wales, eTendersNI, YORtender and Irish eTenders. Checked October 2026.
- [Public Sector Tendering Guides for Small Contractors](https://tendderr.com/guides/): Free guides for small contractors: Procurement Act 2023, CDP registration, frameworks and dynamic markets, social value, and where to find tenders.

## Free tools
- [Tender Readiness Checker: Are You Ready to Bid?](https://tendderr.com/tools/tender-readiness-checker.html): Free tender readiness checker: answer 11 quick questions and see what to sort before you bid for public-sector work. No sign-up, nothing stored.
- [Tender Timeline Calculator: Work Back From the Deadline](https://tendderr.com/tools/tender-timeline-calculator.html): Free tender timeline calculator: enter the tender deadline and work back to your own milestones in working or calendar days. Download to your calendar.
- [Social Value and PPN 002 Checklist for Tenders](https://tendderr.com/tools/social-value-checklist.html): Free social value checklist for tenders, based on GOV.UK guidance: PPN 002 now and the PPN 026 Social Value Model from 1 January 2027.
- [Free Tender Tools for Small Contractors](https://tendderr.com/tools/): Free tender tools for small contractors: a tender readiness checker, a tender timeline calculator and a social value checklist. No sign-up, nothing stored.

## Regions
- [Public Sector Tenders in England for Small Contractors](https://tendderr.com/regions/england.html): Public-sector tenders in England: Find a Tender, Contracts Finder and regional portals such as YORtender, plus Central Digital Platform registration. Free alerts.
- [Public Sector Tenders in Wales: Sell2Wales Help](https://tendderr.com/regions/wales.html): Public-sector tenders in Wales: Sell2Wales, the Welsh Digital Platform, Central Digital Platform registration and the Welsh rules. Free alerts, fixed-fee bid help.
- [Public Sector Tenders in Northern Ireland: eTendersNI Help](https://tendderr.com/regions/northern-ireland.html): Public-sector tenders in Northern Ireland: eTendersNI, Find a Tender, share codes and Irish eTenders across the border. Free alerts, fixed-fee bid help.
- [Public Sector Tenders by Region: England, Wales, NI](https://tendderr.com/regions/): Public-sector tenders in England, Wales and Northern Ireland: where they are published, what to register for, and how Tendderr helps. Sourced from official guidance.
